lines.name: l1
lines.text: God answered snakebite with a snake on a pole. I am Moses, and I made it. My people were dying of snakebites, because they had spoken against God. They came to me: "We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee".

lines.name: l2
lines.text: I prayed. Instead of taking the snakes away, God told me to make a serpent of brass, and set it on a pole. Whoever was bitten looked at it, and lived. Long after me, Jesus told a man named Nicodemus:

lines.name: l3
lines.text: “And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.”

lines.name: l4
lines.text: My brass serpent was only a picture. On the cross, Jesus took on Himself the sin that bites us all, and Paul says He was "made a curse for us". Lifted up where all can see, He is the cure.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: Lift your eyes to Him, and live.
